label: RT-AC5300 tri-band router
description: ASUS RT-AC5300 - Wi-Fi 5 AC5300 tri-band (2.4 GHz 1000 Mbps plus two 5 GHz radios at 2167 Mbps each) with 1x 1G WAN, 4x 1G LAN, USB 2.0 and USB 3.0. Older 802.11ac design, often reused as an AiMesh node.
notes: Three radios, not two: the AC5300 class is one 2.4 GHz plus two independent 5 GHz radios. No 2.5G or 10G ports at all, so it cannot be the wired backbone of a multi-gig lab. 4x4 on all three bands.
